data: In the top right plot, does the blue line with circles reach an accuracy of approximately 0.8 at the x-axis value of 1M?

The top right plot is the second subfigure in the compound figure. The blue line with circles represents SDAE (sent), which is one of the models being compared. The x-axis represents the number of parallel sentences, and the y-axis represents the nearest neighbor translation accuracy. The legend indicates that the blue line with circles corresponds to SDAE (sent) and has an average accuracy of 67.57% when using 1M parallel sentences. The x-axis value of 1M corresponds to the point where the blue line with circles intersects the y-axis. At this point, the accuracy appears to be approximately 0.8. Therefore, the answer to the question is yes, the blue line with circles reaches an accuracy of approximately 0.8 at the x-axis value of 1M.
